_meta.note: Verified real distinct Greek swimmable beaches missing from dataset. Nopigia OSM duplicate collapsed to one (dropped way/377197112).
deferred: Αμμουδαριά (Andros) — Andros is a fully-curated windProfile island (wind suite asserts 41/41 override coverage); adding an unverified beach needs a manual windProfile override first. Deferred.

beaches.verifyReason: Multiple independent sources (Wikipedia, allovergreece, beachsearcher, municipality of Salamina) confirm Δημήτρανι is a large organized pebble swimming beach with showers/changing rooms in SE Salamina (Perani Gulf), Attica, Greece; allovergreece coords (37.90103, 23.49483) match the OSM pin within ~70m, Google type=beach with 64 ratings, and it is ~3.7km from and unrelated to our nearest beach Παραλία Αγίου Νικολάου.

Multiple independent Greek travel sources (argosaronikos.gr, enjoysalamina.gr, visit-salamina.gr, Tripadvisor, 103 Google ratings) confirm Κακή Βίγλα is a real unorganized public swimmable beach on Salamina island in the Saronic Gulf (Greece), free access, ~5.7km from our nearest listed beach, so it is distinct and not foreign or a non-beach venue.

Multiple Greek tourism sources (allovergreece, enjoysalamina, tripinview, visit-salamina) confirm Κύριζα is a real public organized sandy swimmable beach on south Salamina with showers/toilets at GPS 37.90061,23.48936 (matching the OSM pin within ~40m); it is in Greece (Attica) and clearly distinct from our nearest beach Άγιος Νικόλαος 3311m away.

Multiple independent Greek/tourism sources (allovergreece, e-nearme, enjoysalamina, tripinview, Salamina municipality) describe Ντουλάπι as a real sandy/pebble swimmable beach on western Salamina, Attica with crystal-clear waters and a 4.9/5 Google rating; it is in Greece (not foreign), not in our dataset, and distinct from the nearest existing beach Αγίου Νικολάου 5057m away.

Multiple independent beach directories (allovergreece, tripinview, beachatlas, Salamina municipality, Tripadvisor) confirm Perani as a real sandy/pebble swimmable beach on the south coast of Salamina island, Saronic Gulf, Greece, matching the OSM pin and Google "beach" type (143 ratings); it is in Greece (not Turkey/Albania) and is a distinct beach 2827 m from our existing Παραλία Αγίου Νικολάου.

Πόρτο Φίνο is a real coastal hamlet/swimming spot on Salamina (Attica, Greece) — official Salamina tourism, mapcarta, and Greek "where to swim in Salamina" guides describe a public swimming spot with clear deep turquoise water; not in our dataset (no Fino/Φίνο match) and 5.4 km from the nearest existing beach, so genuinely distinct.

Official Salamina tourism site (visit-salamina.gr) and multiple Greek travel articles describe Παραλία Χαρουπιάς as a real quiet sand-and-pebble public beach on Salamina's southern/SW coast; Google type=beach with 108 ratings 18m from the pin, and it is 5.3km from our nearest beach (Αγίου Νικολάου), so distinct and not a duplicate.

Αλμυρίχι/Αρμυρίχι is a well-documented sandy-pebble cove beach in Mesochoria, southern Evia (mainland Greece), confirmed by Tripadvisor (with 2026 reviews), multiple Greek travel blogs and beachsearcher; Google Places type=beach with 1035 ratings 25m from the pin, and it is a distinct beach 2132m from our existing Λιμνιώνα.

OSM way 510509596 is tagged natural=beach with nodes shared on the actual coastline (way 140418375), MapCarta and Google Places both classify it as a beach (type=beach, 21 ratings, 7m from pin) on the Stylida mainland coast in Phthiotis, Greece; it is 6.1km from Νησιώτισσα so not a duplicate, has a distinct proper name, and is firmly in Greece (not Turkey/Albania).
beaches.slotNote: mainland Phthiotis coast (across the N. Euboean Gulf from Evia); nearest beach is on the Evia side

beaches.verifyReason: Multiple independent beach guides (BeachAtlas, Sandee, somemaps, beaches-searcher) plus Google Places (type=beach, 63 ratings, 13m from pin) confirm Dermária as a real unorganized pebble-and-sand swimmable beach in Central Greece (Pelasgia/Stylida, Phthiotis side of the North Euboean Gulf, access via Agios Sostis), and it is a distinct beach from the organized fine-sand Νησιώτισσα 5.8 km away on the Evia side, not a duplicate, bar, resort, or foreign location.
beaches.slotNote: mainland Phthiotis coast (across the N. Euboean Gulf from Evia); nearest beach is on the Evia side

beaches.verifyReason: Multiple Crete beach guides (Greeka, cretanbeaches, terrabook, discoverkissamos) describe Νωπήγεια/Nopigia as a long sandy organized public swimmable beach east of Kissamos in Chania, Crete; Google type="beach" (110 ratings, 55m from pin) confirms it, and it is 5.6km from the distinct "Παραλία Τελώνιο" so not a duplicate.

Multiple independent sources (feelgreece.com, visitkavala.gr, govmap.gr with 40 reviews 4.7/5, sandee.com) confirm Paralia Folia is a real coarse-sand swimmable beach in mainland Kavala near the Tower of Apollonia, Google type=beach with 72 ratings 173m from the pin, and it is 5.7km from and distinct from our nearest beach (the Nudist Beach), in Greece not Turkey/Albania.

Multiple sources (AllTrails, World Beach Guide, AtCorfu) confirm Korfovounia/Korfovonia is a real distinct pebble swimming cove in the Erimitis area of NE Corfu near Kassiopi/Sinies, ~2.5 km from Kogevina; OSM tags it natural=beach and Google Places shows 11 ratings 37m from the pin (the AllTrails "Kefalonia" slug is an error — all content places it on Corfu, Greece, not Albania).

OSM tags it natural=beach (name:el Μοσχοφίλι, name:en Moshofili) on the Greek NE Corfu coast east of Kassiopi (in the Erimitis cluster), and an independent beach listing describes it as a secluded fine-sand cove with calm swimmable water on calm days; it is 1550 m from our Kogevina Beach, so a genuinely distinct Greek beach, not a bar/duplicate/Albanian feature.

Multiple guides (Greeka, BeachAtlas/Sandee at 39.7543/19.9414 — matching the OSM pin) confirm Kerasia is a real ~275m public pebble swimming beach on Corfu's NE coast near Kassiopi/Agios Stefanos Sinies, with 1106 Google ratings type=beach; our nearest "Galiskari/Gialiskari" is on the opposite (west) coast near Pelekas, so it is a genuinely distinct Greek beach we lack.

Multiple independent sources (MyGreekHeart, exploring-greece.gr, a dedicated TripAdvisor page for "Paralia Almyrou, Kiparissos, Laconia") confirm a real wild pebble swimmable beach with clear aquamarine water and a cave near Kyparissos in East Mani, Laconia; Google type=beach with 229 ratings 16m from the pin, and it is ~5.3km from and on a different coast/village than the boat-access Androgialos beach near Porto Kagio, so not a duplicate or foreign.

Multiple Greek travel sources confirm Diros beach is a real public pebble swimming beach in Diros bay (Mani, Lakonia, Peloponnese mainland) below the famous Diros Caves with free umbrellas/loungers; Google type="beach" (371 ratings, 36 m from pin), and nearest existing "Οίτυλο" is a separate bay 5.7 km away, so it is distinct and not foreign.

OSM "Μονατήρι" is a spelling variant of Monastiri/Monastiria, a real public sand-and-pebble swimming beach on western Antiparos (Cyclades, Greece), confirmed by the official Antiparos municipality site, TripAdvisor (93+ Google ratings, type=beach, 58 m from pin), and multiple guides; it is a separate beach from Livadia, which the same sources list distinctly on the other side of the island.

Koutsomiti (Κουτσομύτη) is a documented pristine pebbly islet beach off Astypalaia (Dodecanese, Greece) covered by Greeka, TripAdvisor (136 Google ratings, type=beach), and travel.gr; it is a separate islet from Kounoupi/Kounoupa (our nearest "Κούνουπες"), reachable by daily boat trips, so it is a genuine distinct Greek swimmable beach.

Greeka, Skopelos.com and other travel guides confirm Αγγελετού/Aggeletou is a real non-organized sand-and-pebble swimmable cove on Skopelos' NE coast near Perivoliou, distinct from Agios Ioannis (~3.9 km away), and Google Places shows type=beach with 23 ratings 25 m from the OSM pin.

Multiple independent sources (Greeka, Lonely Planet, Skopelos.com, TripAdvisor) plus Google Places (type="beach", 565 ratings, 24m from pin) confirm Perivoliou is a real secluded pebble/sand swimmable beach on NE Skopelos near Glossa, distinct from our nearest "Άγιος Ιωάννης" 4.1km away.
